newsitem.title: USA: RTRS-U.S. says space probe to crash in Australia.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-U.S. says space probe to crash in Australia.

text.p: Russia's Mars space probe, carrying cannisters of plutonium, was expected to crash in East-Central Australia, the White House announced on Sunday.
The White House said impact was expected at about 8 p.m. EST on Sunday (0100 GMT Monday).

White House press secretary Mike McCurry issued a statement saying the United States "believes the size of the probe is large enough to give pieces of it a chance of urviving re-entry, though most of the space craft will burn up in the atmosphere."
The space craft contains reinforced cannisters of deadly plutonium that pose a lethal threat if they crack open.
The United States is prepared to offer all necessary assistance to any nation to deal with any resuling problems, McCurry said.
